title: Produce User Documentation
description: Produce a state-of-the-art, step-by-step end-user guide (PDF + Markdown) for an RPG or CL program, with annotated screenshots captured from a live IBM i session. User documentation only - no technical documentation.

source_file.label: Select RPG or CL source to document
source_file.description: Program to write the user guide for. Select more than one to produce a separate guide per program.

prompt.label: Select RPG or CL source to document

audience_level.label: Who is the guide for?
audience_level.description: Sets the reading level and how much background the guide explains.

options.label: First-time user
options.description: Assumes no prior 5250 experience - includes sign-on and navigation basics

options.label: Everyday user
options.description: Knows the menus, needs the tasks for this program

options.label: Power user / supervisor
options.description: Shortcuts, edge cases, error recovery and data-integrity notes

options.label: PDF and Markdown
options.description: Recommended - printable guide plus a wiki-ready copy

options.label: Markdown only
options.description: For Confluence or a wiki - screenshots still produced as PNG files

application_name.label: Application / product name
application_name.description: Business name shown on the cover page, e.g. "Customer Master". Leave blank to let the agent derive one from the program.

entry_path.label: How users reach this program
entry_path.description: Known menu path, option number or command, e.g. "Main Menu, option 1". Leave blank and the agent will work it out and verify it live.

brand_company.label: Organisation name
brand_company.description: Shown on the cover page and in the Getting Help section.

doc_language.label: Document language
doc_language.description: Language the guide is written in.
